newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei ends 2 pct higher, disregards politics.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei ends 2 pct higher, disregards politics.

text.p: Tokyo stocks held on to earlier gains to close more than two percent higher on Friday. But the rises were mainly attributed to technical buying, linked to the futures trade. Brokers said the launch of a new Japanese administration was not a major factor in the market.
The key 225-share Nikkei average soared 429.93 points or 2.07 percent to end at 21,201.04. Its December futures gained 350 points to 21,200.
"Today's rally had nothing to do with politics. The political factor is neutral (to the market) for now," said Haruyoshi Mabuchi, chief strategist at Nikko Research Center.
